ov: The common blackbird, a thrush of woods and gardens. The male is black with a yellow bill and eye-ring and sings a rich, melodious song; the female is mainly dark brown. It builds a neat cup-shaped nest bound with mud.
rg: Europe, western Asia and North Africa; introduced to Australia and New Zealand.
fx: The oldest ringed blackbird lived 21 years and 10 months, though the average is 2.4 years.
The male sings mainly from March to June, from trees and rooftops.
